name: Fuse Pay Card
summary: Virtual Visa prepaid card for stablecoin spending. Zero-fee swaps via Jupiter. No seed phrases - uses multi-sig and biometrics. Issued by Lead Bank. US only (except NY, LA, FL, AK).

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Virtual card only, no physical card

faq.question: Does the Fuse Pay Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No. There is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Fuse Pay Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.
